ai.seo_question: What does it mean that there is no 'idle talk' in Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the complete elimination of *laghw* (vain talk) as a sign of spiritual perfection and divine favor, ensuring that the inhabitants' attention remains solely on the contemplation of Allah and His blessings. This purity of discourse reflects the inner tranquility of the soul, free from the distractions of worldly trivialities that characterize earthly life.
